# Instructables

> > A maker community platform owned by Autodesk where creators share step-by-step DIY projects, tutorials, and how-to guides across crafts, technology, and hands-on learning.

Founded by Squid Labs members including Saul Griffith and Eric Wilhelm, Instructables has become a leading platform for the maker movement, hosting contests, educational resources for K-12 teachers, and projects featuring Arduino, Micro:bit, and MakeyMakey. The site connects makers worldwide to document and share their creative work.

## Key Topics

- DIY projects and tutorials
- Maker movement and community
- STEM education and K-12 classroom resources
- Arduino, Micro:bit, and MakeyMakey projects
- Autodesk (parent company)
- Squid Labs (founding organization)
- Project sharing and publishing platform
- Maker Faire participation
- Hands-on learning
- Contests and challenges
- Saul Griffith and Eric Wilhelm (founders)
- Smithsonian's Cooper-Hewitt recognition
- Getting started guides
